build_method: Option B (hybrid HTML overlay). v1 (96c75eb) had no patriotic motif at all -- the original duotono/gold-key-light barbershop interior, per design-system.md's default photography rule -- and only mentioned the holiday in the small caption line. User asked to put something from Independence Day into the image. First attempt at v2 regenerated the whole background in full color with a large flag baked into the photo (mirroring the sibling post posts/instagram/dia-independencia-guatemala/'s approach) -- user rejected that: keep the original barbershop photo exactly as it was, only add the flag and change the letter colors, nothing more. v2 kept the original v1 duotono/gold background completely untouched and added a small flat Guatemalan flag badge (hand-drawn inline SVG) next to the 'Horario especial' pill. User reviewed v2 and reversed course: the flag read as too small and wanted it 'de fondo, grande, en horizontal' -- a real background element, not a small chip. First attempt at v3 tried a full-bleed photographic flag plate layered *behind* the existing chair photo (chair at reduced opacity on top) -- user interrupted mid-render and rejected this too: the double-exposure blend made the flag and the chair muddy and illegible together, and clarified they wanted the flag 'como un elemento atras de la escena' -- i.e. a real spatial prop within the photographed scene (like the sibling post's approach), not a translucent graphic layered over the whole canvas. v3 (this revision, final) regenerates the single background photo (assets/bg.png / assets/bg-story.png) as one scene: the same duotono/gold-key-light barbershop chair and styling station, with a large Guatemalan flag now mounted on a wall-bracket flagpole behind/above the chair, flying outward horizontally (not draped like a curtain), rendered in its true accent colors as the one deliberate selective-color element in an otherwise duotone frame -- same 'brand exception' logic already used for the celeste UI accents, extended to this one photographic element per the user's explicit new instruction (superseding the earlier 'keep the photo untouched' constraint from the v1->v2 round). The flag chip and its dedicated CSS were removed from the eyebrow row, which now holds only the pill. Accent color (pill, headline highlight word, hours time) stays celeste (#4997D0), unchanged since v2. raw/prompt-bg-v3-escena*.txt + raw/bg-v3-escena*.png are the final backgrounds (promoted to assets/); raw/prompt-bg-v3-bandera*.txt + raw/bg-v3-bandera-fullbleed*.png are the rejected full-bleed double-exposure attempt; raw/prompt-bg-v2*.txt + raw/bg-v2-bandera*.png are the earlier rejected full-color scene regeneration; raw/bg-v1-duotono-sin-muro*.png are the original flag-less backgrounds. All kept for reference. Rendered to PNG via headless Chrome at --force-device-scale-factor=2 (1080x1350 -> 2160x2700 feed, 1080x1920 -> 2160x3840 story). The hours row (10 AM-5 PM) is set in Fira Sans Condensed, never Lost in South, because that font is missing the 0/2/8 digit glyphs. This is the operational post (special hours, no different from any other day-of-service announcement) -- distinct from the purely commemorative posts/instagram/dia-independencia-guatemala/ post about the same date; do not merge or confuse the two.
headline: El 15 de septiembre / Sí abrimos
caption_on_image: Día de la Independencia — agenda tu cita con tiempo.
